create.name: Sophie Bashford
create.bio:
Sophie Bashford is an English writer and intuitive teacher whose work centres on the sacred feminine and the many faces of the Goddess. Brought up by her father in Cambridge after losing her mother young, she came to spiritual practice in her mid-twenties, when her first pregnancy set off a period of deep change and opened an intuitive sense she had not known she had. She now lives in Brighton, near the South Downs, and her book You Are a Goddess, published by Hay House, leads readers through encounters with nine goddess figures from different cultures. She has also created two oracle decks, Goddesses, Gods and Guardians and The Earth and Sky Oracle.

Her teaching mixes myth, guided visualisation and ritual. She has spoken at Hay House UK events, Alternatives in London and the Mind Body Spirit Festival, and has recorded two collections of guided meditation journeys in which listeners meet goddesses, gods and elemental guardians in their temples. Her longer programme, the Moon Temple Journey, is a year-long online course with live Zoom sessions and a community group, followed by an advanced Sacred Circle and in-person Healing Tent retreats, and she runs shorter online courses devoted to single goddesses such as Hecate.

books.title: You Are a Goddess
books.author: Sophie Bashford
books.description: Sophie's first book introduces a series of goddess archetypes from different traditions and how to work with each through ritual, reflection and meditation. It is written for women who want to bring the sacred feminine into everyday life.

books.title: Goddesses, Gods and Guardians Oracle Cards
books.author: Sophie Bashford
books.description: A deck of 44 cards with a guidebook, each card drawing on a deity or guardian figure from world myth. It is meant for daily reflection and for readings that ask what a situation is calling for.

courses.title: Meditation Journeys with Goddesses, Gods and Guardians
courses.description: Two audio collections of eight guided visualisations each, voiced by Sophie, in which the listener visits a goddess, god or guardian such as Inanna, Kuan Yin, Ra or Apollo. Available as downloads and through audio apps.
courses.price: Price set by each store (Hay House, Audible, Spotify Premium)

free_resources.title: Podcasts & more free resources
free_resources.description: A collection of free podcast interviews in which Sophie talks about her path and the goddess figures she works with, including a guided journey to meet Hecate at the end of one episode.
